summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running any tests or code, and without committing. Changes: monai/data/grid_dataset.py adds PatchIter (exported and in __all__) and reworks GridPatchDataset to take dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; monai/data/utils.py makes iter_patch yield (patch, coords) and set_rnd skip double-underscore attributes; monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst gains a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py is new with TestGridPatchDataset (test_shape, test_loading_array, plus an extra test_missing_length). Choices to check: both images in test_loading_array are np.arange(16).reshape(1,4,4), since the spec gave no image values; setUp and the test body both call set_determinism(1234). Not verified: the pinned single-process and two-worker values, the docstring example output, and black formatting. Lines 232-234 of utils.py exceed 120 columns, but that text predates this change. Next step: run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py to confirm the pinned values.
